assets.name: Hinode Film
assets.role: The colour look. A display-referred 3D LUT applied after tone mapping, carrying the contrast curve, split toning, and saturation shaping that a linear grade multiplier cannot express. Applied by every scene through the same post chain.

pipeline.notes: Generated by scripts/build-lut.mjs from scripts/lib/lut.mjs. Size chosen by measurement, not convention: scripts/build-lut.mjs --analyse reconstructs each candidate table and reports the error it introduces. Values are 0-1 floats written as bin centres, because LUTCubeLoader truncates when it scales and bin centres survive that.

assets.name: Boulder 01 — 1K scanned prop
assets.role: First real mesh through the derivation pipeline, and a rock for the Hinode Prefecture forest floor (Phase 5).

reductions: simplify (ratios 0.8, 0.4, 0.16; levels 1+ merge position seams first)
pipeline.notes: 3 levels of detail share one texture set in one file; the runtime picks a level by distance, so the closest keeps its full detail and the farthest costs a fraction of it. Textures are KTX2 (Basis ETC1S), transcoded on the GPU to BC7/ASTC/ETC2 so the browser never holds a decoded 1K RGBA image per texture, and colour-space aware — albedo is sRGB, normal and packed maps are linear.
